method: Built-in image generation for visual studies; final native 16x16 pixel grids in tools/gen_card_textures.py (--new-items-only).

items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Minecraft Applied Crafted Energistics inventory item; native 16x16 pixel sprite, shown as a crisp integer enlargement. Reference sheet: first row shows existing placeholder icons to replace; the second row shows AE2 upgrade card art. Match AE2 19.2's minimal pixel style. Use only solid square logical pixels; no tiny subpixels, no gradients, no blur. Transparent outside the item, no background, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. This item is NOT an upgrade card and NOT a vessel containing usable gas. It carries a gas ID used to mark a machine's gas configuration slot. Draw a compact soft stepped CYAN GAS PUFF CLUSTER with a SMALL WHITE IDENTIFICATION TAG overlapping its lower-right corner. Three rounded square pixel puffs form the cloud; two shades and one highlight, muted teal outline. The tag is about 4x5 logical pixels with a tiny dark identification mark, conveying a gas sample token. No card chassis, no side connector, no bottle, no liquid level, no droplet, no battery. Fit inside a 14x14 area with transparent margins. Palette teal #548c9c/#6ca4b2/#9cccd6, gray #61666d and silver #dedfe2.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Minecraft Applied Crafted Energistics inventory item; native 16x16 pixel sprite, shown as a crisp integer enlargement. Reference sheet: first row shows existing placeholder icons to replace; the second row shows AE2 upgrade card art. Match AE2 19.2's minimal pixel style. Use only solid square logical pixels; no tiny subpixels, no gradients, no blur. Transparent outside the item, no background, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Keep the established AE2 card silver frame, blank gray inner face, bottom red contact and ADVANCED CYAN right connector unchanged. Replace the central glyph with THREE INDEPENDENT VERTICAL SLIDERS with their adjustment knobs at DIFFERENT HEIGHTS. This card unlocks independent input/output/bidirectional/off modes for nine cache slots, and remembers the modes. Three sliders stand for independently controlled channels, not merely extra storage slots. Use a compact engraved dark-gray glyph and a subtle one-pixel pale-gray lower highlight, occupying at most 8x8 logical pixels. No plus, no six dots, no central pressure gauge, no literal numeral, no extra text.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Minecraft Applied Crafted Energistics inventory item; native 16x16 pixel sprite, shown as a crisp integer enlargement. Reference sheet: first row shows existing placeholder icons to replace; the second row shows AE2 upgrade card art. Match AE2 19.2's minimal pixel style. Use only solid square logical pixels; no tiny subpixels, no gradients, no blur. Transparent outside the item, no background, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Keep the established AE2 card silver frame, blank gray inner face and bottom red contact, but use the BASIC GOLD right connector (its recipe uses AE2 basic_card). The central glyph MUST be a DANGER WARNING TRIANGLE WITH AN EXCLAMATION MARK: thin dark-gray triangular outline and small red exclamation mark, readable at 16x16. It means automatic safety venting when the interface reaches dangerous real pressure (20 atm), not ownership or security lockout. At most 8x8 logical pixels. Do not draw a padlock, shield, key, pressure gauge or generic plus.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Minecraft Applied Crafted Energistics inventory item; native 16x16 pixel sprite, shown as a crisp integer enlargement. Reference sheet: first row shows existing placeholder icons to replace; the second row shows AE2 upgrade card art. Match AE2 19.2's minimal pixel style. Use only solid square logical pixels; no tiny subpixels, no gradients, no blur. Transparent outside the item, no background, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Keep the established AE2 card silver frame, blank gray inner face, bottom red contact and ADVANCED CYAN right connector unchanged. This card sets a configurable pressure TARGET on import/export buses (1/2/4/8/12/16 atm): export stops at the target and import draws only above it. It does NOT raise maximum capacity like the old pressure_card. Central symbol: a horizontal pressure scale / segmented bar crossed by ONE CLEAR TARGET MARKER, with a tiny adjustable control knob above, conveying a selected threshold. Make the threshold a vertical line over a short horizontal scale, with lower/higher portions visually distinct by gray shades. Engraved dark-gray symbol with pale-gray offset highlights, maximum 8x8 logical pixels. No upward pressure-boost arrow, no large semicircular dial identical to the existing pressure_card, no text.
